title: GPT-5.5 hallucinates 3x more than MIT-licensed GLM-5.2
summary: A technical benchmark comparison article demonstrating that GPT-5.5 produces hallucinations three times more frequently than the MIT-licensed GLM-5.2 model, suggesting potential reliability advantages for the open-source alternative.
problem_solved: Quantifies and compares hallucination rates between proprietary and open-source large language models
why_valuable: Provides empirical evidence that open-source models like GLM-5.2 may offer better reliability than proprietary alternatives for certain use cases
